evidence_policy.mutation_rule: Task-scoped changes require a reviewed Pantheon PR; append a record_log entry whenever the accepted evidence cut or formal review state changes. The governed approve command binds REVIEW_FILE and posts the commit status but never edits this manifest, so the owner transcribes the already-issued reviewer verdict into record_log at closeout and logs that transcription as a separate owner entry citing the authoritative task-state event.

task.evidence_cut_semantics: Owner evidence cut for independent review. The delivery makes the loop catalog state which controllers actually exist, adds catalog-to-runtime exactness validation in both directions, and proves all-loop controller-record conformance plus tenant-scoped operator-truth readback through the BFF read models. No maturity is promoted and no liveness is admitted.

task.title: Backend/controller/operator truth surfaces for L12

actual_state: domain terminal actual-state observation carried on the controller record
desired_state: domain desired-state observation carried on the controller record

scope.authoritative_write_owner: The loop-control store owns every write to loop_controller_records under the (tenant_id, environment, loop_id) identity key. The loop catalog owns the declared controller contract. The BFF is a read-only projector of both and never manufactures liveness.
scope.not_changing: No change to liveness admission rules, maturity levels, evidence_profile statuses, controller implementations, the loop-control store or writer, the loop catalog JSON schema, or services/control-plane/bff/main.py. No loop is promoted to reconciled or proven-live.
scope.owned_layer: Operator truth surfaces: the loop catalog's declared controller contract, the BFF loop-inventory projection of that declaration, and the contract tests that bind catalog claims to runtime implementation and prove all-loop record conformance with tenant-scoped readback.

pre_deploy.surface: BFF v5 loop-inventory and loop-health read models, exercised in-process at the recorded head
pre_deploy.note: All twelve canonical loops read back desired-state presence, controller health, last success, last failure, downstream actual state, and provenance under the authenticated tenant and environment. None is admitted as live truth because the catalog does not yet admit any live claim.

proof: The controller record identity key remains (tenant_id, environment, loop_id); this task adds no new write path.

test_every_canonical_loop_record_conforms_and_reads_back_tenant_scoped feeds one record per loop plus a second consultation record scoped to another tenant, and asserts the foreign record's evidence ref never appears on any projected loop.

test_stale_and_contradicted_records_stay_unaccepted_for_every_loop drives all twelve loops through three refusal cases: a stale heartbeat, archive-only evidence refs, and contradicted evidence provenance.

In every case controller_health.current_record_accepted is false, evidence_packet.accepted_live_liveness is false, and operator_truth.degraded is true, with a specific rejection_reason on each loop whose catalog contract is implemented.
The loop-health surface reports status degraded and controller_health_record_count 0 for the stale case rather than hiding the loops.

Each projected loop carries evidence_packet.source, runtime_record_evidence_basis, runtime_evidence_refs, and highest_truth_level, so an operator can trace a displayed value back to the controller record that produced it.
archived_task_completion_accepted stays false on every loop, so task-archive completion is visible as reference-only and never as runtime correlation.

The catalog now records each implemented controller's restart_behavior, and test_loop_catalog_controller_contract_matches_runtime_implementation asserts the named controller module actually contains the durable state-path environment variable and identity-refresh symbols that behavior describes: SOURCE_INGEST_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH and refresh_runtime_identity for source_ingestion, DISTILLATION_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH and refresh_runtime_identity for strategy_distillation, and ALPHA_REPLICATION_CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH for alpha_replication.

A controller restart produces a fresh heartbeat; the read model accepts a record only inside the 900 second freshness window, and the negative control that widened that window was caught by the all-loop staleness test.

Controller restart and recovery behavior itself is owned and proved by L12-CTRL-001 and L12-MANIFEST-RESTART-PROOF-20260729; this task binds the catalog's description of it to the code that implements it.
The delivery is a static catalog change plus read-model and test changes; reverting the task commits restores the previous catalog exactly.
No stored data is migrated and no runtime write path is altered, so there is nothing to compensate.

environment_boundary.note: Loop-health reads remain bound to the deployed PANTHEON_ENV unless the authenticated identity declares broader environments; a request for another environment is rejected with 403 environment_scope.

hosted_frontend.note: No frontend file is changed by this task.

no_live_capital.note: No trading, broker, or capital path is touched. capital_pool_execution keeps controller_contract.status not_implemented and gains no liveness.

rbac.note: Both read models keep their existing read-role requirement; the unchanged strict-JWT test asserts 401 without a token and 403 for audit_only.

tenant_isolation.note: test_every_canonical_loop_record_conforms_and_reads_back_tenant_scoped proves a foreign-tenant controller record never reaches the authenticated tenant's view, and meta.scope reports the resolved tenant and environment.

two_person_approval.note: Owner Claude2 and reviewer Antigravity are distinct; the delivery merges through a reviewed task PR into dev.

acceptance.statement: All twelve canonical loops emit current tenant-scoped controller records that satisfy the shared controller-record contract and read back through the BFF under the authenticated tenant and environment.
The BFF shows desired-state presence, controller health, last success, last failure, downstream actual state, and provenance for every loop.
Stale, absent, and contradicted records remain unaccepted and visibly degraded for every loop, with a specific rejection reason.

Catalog controller names, queries, restart behavior, and liveness fields match the implementation, checked in both directions: a catalog claim without a deployed controller fails, and a deployed controller absent from the catalog fails.

Maturity is no higher than implemented until hosted evidence is admitted: no catalog loop declares reconciled or proven-live maturity, a proven_live controller contract, or present live evidence, and zero loops are admitted as live by the read model.

nine_loops_without_a_canonical_controlle.containment: Those nine loops keep controller_contract.status not_implemented with null contract fields, the exactness test forbids them from declaring contract fields, and the read model reports controller_health.status not_implemented with rejection_reason 'catalog controller contract is not implemented' even when a record is present.
nine_loops_without_a_canonical_controlle.description: Only source_ingestion, strategy_distillation, and alpha_replication run a canonical loop-control controller today. The other nine canonical loops emit no controller record from a named controller. This task records that fact rather than concealing it; building those controllers is not in this task's scope.
